SELECT COUNT(*) FROM image_board ib JOIN users u ON ib.reg_user = u.user_no WHERE ib.use_yn = 'Y'
AND ( ib.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )

SELECT ib.board_no AS boardNo , ib.title AS title , ib.content AS content , ib.reg_user AS regUser , ru.user_name AS regUserName , DATE_FORMAT(ib.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regDate , ib.hit AS hit , ib.thumb_file_no AS thumbFileNo , mu.user_name AS modUserName , DATE_FORMAT(ib.mod_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS modDate FROM image_board ib JOIN users ru ON ib.reg_user = ru.user_no LEFT JOIN users mu ON ib.mod_user = mu.user_no WHERE ib.board_no = #{boardNo} AND ib.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_board ( board_no, title, content, thumb_file_no, hit, use_yn, reg_date, reg_user ) VALUES ( #{boardNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{thumbFileNo}, 0, 'Y', NOW(), #{regUser} )

INSERT INTO file_master ( board_no, file_path, file_name, org_name, file_ext, file_size, sort_ord, use_yn, reg_user ) VALUES ( #{boardNo}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{orgName}, #{fileExt}, #{fileSize}, #{sortOrd}, 'Y', #{regUser} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_no AS fileNo , board_no AS boardNo , file_path AS filePath , file_name AS fileName , org_name AS orgName , file_ext AS fileExt , file_size AS fileSize , sort_ord AS sortOrd FROM file_master WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_ord ASC, file_no ASC

SELECT file_no AS fileNo , board_no AS boardNo , file_path AS filePath , file_name AS fileName , org_name AS orgName , file_ext AS fileExt , file_size AS fileSize FROM file_master WHERE file_no = #{fileNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
